name: Belmond Cadogan Hotel
positioning: A historic Chelsea townhouse hotel in London, between Knightsbridge and the King's Road, with a literary past tied to Oscar Wilde and Lillie Langtry
best_for: Travelers who like history, books and literary stories
Guests who want a quiet London base near Knightsbridge and the King's Road

facts.text: The hotel sits on a quiet corner between Knightsbridge and the King's Road.
The hotel has a side entrance on Pont Street.
Each room has a private curated library.
The Spa Suite offers massages, facials and beauty treatments.
Cadogan's, a lounge, serves afternoon tea.
The hotel has a bar serving classic cocktails.
The hotel can arrange picnics and provide blankets or board games.

highlights.text: Lillie Langtry's former bedroom survives as room 106.
Blue morpho butterflies appear in each room as a nod to Hans Sloane's legacy.
Guests have privileged access to Cadogan Place Gardens.
Oscar Wilde held his pied-a-terre in room 118.

considerations.text: Tennis courts are available at Cadogan Place Gardens, which guests reach through privileged access.
